title: The Gravity of the Deep Revisited
author: Freya Blackwood
blurb: Oscar Blackwood, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
